learnings: 55-day closing breakout (high / low) (long, hold 10 days): median Sharpe 0.20 across 20 markets, win rate 53%, median edge +0.14% per trade vs holding any day, positive in 75% of markets, robust out of sample in 35%.

20-day EMA crosses 50-day EMA (short, hold 20 days): median Sharpe 0.20 across 20 markets, win rate 57%, median edge +0.80% per trade vs holding any day, positive in 70% of markets, robust out of sample in 30%.

20-day EMA crosses 50-day EMA (short, hold 10 days): median Sharpe 0.20 across 20 markets, win rate 54%, median edge +0.39% per trade vs holding any day, positive in 75% of markets, robust out of sample in 35%.

MACD cross with the 200-day trend (long, hold 20 days): median Sharpe 0.19 across 20 markets, win rate 50%, median edge +0.22% per trade vs holding any day, positive in 70% of markets, robust out of sample in 50%.

55-day closing breakout (high / low) (long, hold 20 days): median Sharpe 0.16 across 20 markets, win rate 53%, median edge +0.04% per trade vs holding any day, positive in 85% of markets, robust out of sample in 45%.

Uptrend + close back above 9-day MA after a dip / mirror (long, hold 20 days): median Sharpe 0.15 across 20 markets, win rate 50%, median edge +0.16% per trade vs holding any day, positive in 80% of markets, robust out of sample in 40%.

55-day closing breakout (high / low) (long, hold 5 days): median Sharpe 0.15 across 20 markets, win rate 50%, median edge +0.14% per trade vs holding any day, positive in 70% of markets, robust out of sample in 40%.

20-day EMA crosses 50-day EMA (long, hold 20 days): median Sharpe 0.15 across 20 markets, win rate 48%, median edge -0.17% per trade vs holding any day, positive in 60% of markets, robust out of sample in 35%.

Weakest: Bullish / bearish MACD-histogram divergence (short, 10d, median Sharpe -0.32, win 44%); Stochastic(14) crosses up through 20 / down through 80 (short, 10d, median Sharpe -0.32, win 46%); RSI(2) < 10 / > 90 (long, 5d, median Sharpe -0.30, win 48%); RSI(14) back above 30 / below 70 (short, 20d, median Sharpe -0.30, win 39%); Close 3% below / above the 9-day MA (short, 20d, median Sharpe -0.30, win 49%).
Mean reversion (long): median Sharpe -0.09, win rate 48%, edge -0.28% per trade, 39% of tests positive, 19% robust.
Pullback in trend (long): median Sharpe -0.01, win rate 50%, edge -0.23% per trade, 48% of tests positive, 25% robust.
Crossover (long): median Sharpe -0.02, win rate 48%, edge -0.15% per trade, 47% of tests positive, 24% robust.
Divergence (long): median Sharpe -0.06, win rate 48%, edge -0.08% per trade, 44% of tests positive, 23% robust.
Breakout (long): median Sharpe 0.14, win rate 51%, edge +0.05% per trade, 72% of tests positive, 38% robust.

After a close 3% below the 9-day MA (2826 cases): touches the (falling) 9-day MA within 20 days in 96% of cases (median 6 days) but gets back to the 9-day MA level of the signal day only 50% of the time; average drawdown before that -3.9% (worst -27%), return after 10 days +0.00% (up 50% of the time).

After a close 5% below the 9-day MA (1015 cases): touches the (falling) 9-day MA within 20 days in 96% of cases (median 6 days) but gets back to the 9-day MA level of the signal day only 42% of the time; average drawdown before that -4.9% (worst -28%), return after 10 days +0.04% (up 50% of the time).

After a close 7% below the 9-day MA (389 cases): touches the (falling) 9-day MA within 20 days in 96% of cases (median 7 days) but gets back to the 9-day MA level of the signal day only 37% of the time; average drawdown before that -6.1% (worst -28%), return after 10 days -0.24% (up 46% of the time).

After a close 10% below the 9-day MA (76 cases): touches the (falling) 9-day MA within 20 days in 97% of cases (median 6 days) but gets back to the 9-day MA level of the signal day only 45% of the time; average drawdown before that -6.6% (worst -30%), return after 10 days +5.05% (up 64% of the time).
First dip to the 9-day MA in an uptrend (2332 cases): new 20-day high within 20 days 52%, closed below the 50-day 69%, average dip -4.4%, return after 20 days +0.09% (up 51%).
First dip to the 20-day MA in an uptrend (1568 cases): new 20-day high within 20 days 46%, closed below the 50-day 75%, average dip -4.2%, return after 20 days +0.29% (up 52%).
First dip to the 50-day MA in an uptrend (975 cases): new 20-day high within 20 days 32%, closed below the 50-day 96%, average dip -4.7%, return after 20 days -0.28% (up 48%).
3313 rule x market x holding-period tests: a t-stat around 4.03 is what the luckiest test would show by chance, so prefer rules that work across many markets and in both 2007-18 and 2019+.
